card.name: The word at in preparation instructions
card.fires_on: The word "at" (or "At") right after a preparation, dispensing or administration verb phrase in dosing directions. It introduces a time, place or condition such as "at one time", "at time of dispensing", "at the end of", "at room temperature".

modes.label: At one time / at any time
modes.description: "at" after a preparation or handling clause, before a time phrase such as "one time" or "any time".
modes.example: Up to four doses of DEFITELIO solution may be prepared<< at>> one time, if refrigerated.

modes.label: At the end / at the site / at room temperature
modes.description: "at" after a drug, volume or flush step, before an end point, site or temperature.
modes.example: Flush the line with 0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection, USP<< at>> the end of the intravenous infusion.

modes.label: At time of dispensing or use
modes.description: "at" after a prepare or reconstitute instruction, before a time of dispensing or use.
modes.example: Prepare a suspension<< at>> time of dispensing as follows: Tap

card.plain: It marks the word "at" in mixing and dosing directions, where it begins a phrase saying when, where or under what conditions to do a step.
